profile.headline: Game Developer & Full-stack Software Engineer | Versatile & Solutions-Oriented, works with all sizes of companies in a broad range of technologies
profile.summary: Passionate about product and user experience. I make digital things for humans that are thoughtful, reactive, and surprising. I have experience with a wide range of tech, and I'm always hungry to learn more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Front-end applications development with React, Redux, MUI, and Javascript
- Back-end services development with Golang and Nodejs / Typescript / Javascript
- System orchestration and containerization with k8s, Docker, Helm, and Skaffold
- Metrics and monitoring / alerting with Prometheus and Grafana

positions.title: Software Team Lead
positions.description:
- Agile Scrum Master: Managing a Team of 4-7 Developers and QA Professionals
- Senior Level Developer: Collaboration with Business & Management, Developer Mentorship
- Cloud Software Development: Azure, C#, .NET
- API Design: REST & Resourceful Routes, Documentation & Collaboration with API Consumers
- Exerp Integration

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Project Management, Estimation, and Client Relations
- REST API Development: Rails & Ruby, Python, Laravel & PHP
- Single Page Applications: Angular 1 and 2+, Vue.js
- Linux & Windows Server Administration
- Data Visualizations & UI: D3.js
- Mobile App Development: Xamarin & C#

positions.title: Digital Media & Automation Developer
positions.description:
Development & Maintenance of:
- digital menuboard media for various multi-national clients
- automation / productivity tools for digital and print media teams

Technologies: Flash (AS2, AS3), Javascript, HTML5, CSS, jQuery

company.name: EK3 Technologies Inc. dba Cineplex Digital Networks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Infotech & McLean Co Websites, Various Internal Applications:
- Worked with a small team of talented individuals, maintaining and improving Info-Tech Research Group's world class website, and its integration with the rest of the business and its systems
- Built beautiful, responsive, and intuitive web experiences using Ruby on Rails, HTML5, CSS3, javascript, jQuery, Backbone.js, Pusher, and Ruby on Rails

Salesforce:
- Developed, integrated, and enforced code style, pattern, and code review standards for Salesforce (APEX) solution development
- Performed in-depth code reviews for solutions developed in Salesforce technologies
- Worked with a small team to implement complex customizations in order to support the businesses evolving client acquisition and retention processes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an improved internal Sales Ticker from scratch, utilizing Force.com technologies. Carried development through implementation, testing, release, and maintenance. The improved solution provided clean code, a look and feel consistent with company standards, and near instantaneous push updates. 

- Created and modified Microsoft Business Intelligence reports, often displaying financial data requiring high levels of precision.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Researched, planned, and implemented a new data integration solution for an existing Ruby on Rails website, allowing records to be synchronized to a production Salesforce.com instance.
- Communicated with product owners to develop the requirements of software solutions, in order to better meet their goals

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed and maintained software solutions and the user experience on Info~Tech Research Group's client-facing website. Solutions were developed on the existing website, powered by Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Worked with a small team of developers to produce a mobile version of Info~Tech Research Group's client-facing website. Participated through planning, implementation, testing, release and maintenance of the project.
